title: Episode 88 — Nawab Kapoor Singh Enters the Narrative

blocks.text: This transition page moves out of the last Randhawa material and into the new leadership story, saying that after Sahib Singh’s survival the narrative now turns toward Nawab Kapoor Singh as a defining figure in the Panth’s next phase.
The page functions as an overt episode handoff, using the older heading material to recall the strain after Banda Singh and to introduce Mughal reaction to renewed Sikh resilience.
Its final movement introduces the reaction of the Mughal side to renewed Sikh resilience, making the page the hinge into Kapoor Singh’s contested rise.
